correctness.rationale: The 153/432/297 cubical complex satisfies boundary-square zero. Exact ranks over F3 are 152 and 270; rank of stacked boundary/edge-total-motion map is 162. Since the graph has cycle rank 10, first rational homology maps isomorphically to graph cycles, forcing rank 270 over Q and H2 dimension 27. Degree-two integral homology is a subgroup of a free group and has rank 27. The full 216-element Lefschetz character is computed with orientation signs, and the 13-class group algebra is exactly verified in Q(sqrt3) with six orthonormal normalized simple characters. The verifier was actually executed successfully; no finite sampling extrapolation.

value.rationale: The Pappus incidence graph is a canonical 216-symmetry graph. A complete 13-class homology character and a multiplicity-free decomposition into five distinct rational representations is a natural full equivariant invariant. Its conjugate irrational complex characters, nontrivial one-dimensional summand and absence of invariant cycles distinguish topological symmetries invisible in non-equivariant ranks; it is not an arbitrary small numerical gain.
